statements.quote: Pathak and coworkers investigated high-throughput screening of high entropy alloy (Cu, Co, Ni, Zn, and Sn) based catalysts through machine learning for CO2 hydrogenation to methanol. They found that the activity and selectivity of these catalysts can be successfully predicted and have screened a series of high entropy-based catalysts (from 36 750 considered catalysts) for CO2 hydrogenation to methanol (Fig. 7g–i).
